"And said, Whose word is this, O ye people? a great assembly of people that are debating with a loud voice, and are making noise, and making noise."

32.translation: "Where is this sanctification of unrighteousness? for unrighteously unrighted is the prince of the world, and the prince thereof." "And they that were sinners, and were born poor, were born barren, and did not practice agriculture, and women, and children, and went after me." This is certain.
word_for_word: Is it a picture of sanctifying unrighteousness by unrighteously doing unright?
"For the godly have delivered up the world, and the poor man, and his ruler, and me."
"If any man be a sinner, how shall he be born of the poor?"
"Which of the two women did not practice agriculture?"
"Were not the Shudras learned? they also shall serve me diligently."

33.translation: "And he said unto them, What then sayest ye that the righteous walk after the godly?" Punyas are Brahmins with good qualities. "And the kings and the sages were Kshatriyas." What do you mean by speed beyond these two points? "Wherefore receive thou me as the king of the world, and serve me." "For the last hour, when the Poles made me a joy, and a joyless man, and the dead a want of me? woe unto me, that I may be a goodly workman."

34.translation: According to the bhajan, the shakha is called manmana. "Remember me, and be ye as me;" "In the same way, be my devotee, and be my servant." Be an alcoholic. Namaskrudam to me. "And these are the kinds of things which are done in the air: and when thou hast taken me up, and buried me, thou shalt find me a joyful form of joy."

"Remember me, that he which is of me may be called my Son."

"I am mindful of the silence of these kinds of evils."
